summary: Created a compact reference-only quarantine policy for third-party OpenClaw skills, plugins, tools, adapters, and downloaded code. The policy sets quarantined-by-default handling, defines risk classes and approval statuses, documents hard blockers, and provides a manual review workflow plus sandbox requirements without installing, fetching, or executing any third-party code.
recommended_next_action: Use this quarantine policy before considering any third-party skill or plugin, and if a candidate survives review, open a separate sandbox-only task rather than installing or enabling it directly.
